items.label: GOOD AFTERNOON
items.referenceNote: Learning sequence: GOOD, then AFTERNOON, joined from two complete isolated recordings; not a continuous phrase performance. The legacy Beginner checkpoint trained GOOD AFTERNOON on AFTERNOON only. Repaired Beginner weights use synthetic joined greeting training; natural continuous full-greeting recognition remains unverified.
items.changes: Audio removed; complete source motion retained without trimming; fit/padded to 640×480, 30 fps, H.264/yuv420p with faststart. Two isolated clips concatenated as an explicitly labelled learning sequence.
